title: channels, calls and stages
items: channels in public rooms: text channels, voice channels, video channels and threads. tap the + in the bar under the room name. start a thread from any message with the thread button
voice and video calls: tap the phone or camera in any dm to call someone. voice and video channels in public rooms let up to 10 (voice) or 6 (video) people hang out
stages: mods open a stage where only speakers talk. everyone else listens, raises a hand, and a mod lets them speak
calls ring with a sound or by flashing your tab title, your pick. change it or turn calls off in settings > calls
vouching: get 2 verified friends to vouch for you and you are verified, no id needed. verified people can vouch from the verify screen. vouching for someone who gets banned costs you strikes

title: block world
items: block world is now a real multiplayer blocks server (classicube). open it from + > block world in any public room, you are signed in automatically with your chatroom name
mine, build and explore a shared 3d world with everyone, with a pixel perfection texture pack
it replaces the hangout world, coin rush and big trivia
owner now has unlimited public rooms and bots

title: whiteboards and game nights
items: shared whiteboards: draw together live in any group (group info > whiteboards, or the + menu). pen, colors, text, undo. you can report a board and mods can clear or delete it
game nights: hosts and mods plan a game night in group info, members tap i am in, and everyone going gets a notification when it starts

title: roles, rules, pictures and typo fixes
items: group roles: hosts make named colored roles (group info > roles), give them to people, and they show next to the name in chat
rules gate: hosts write group rules and turn the gate on, so new members have to accept them before they can post
pictures in public groups: verified beta members can send them, anyone can report one, and hosts, mods and admins can remove it
paste a picture anywhere in a chat with ctrl+v to send it (5 MB max)
autocorrect fixes common typos as you type, backspace right after undoes it, and you can turn it off in settings
smart fix (sparkle button) asks an ai to clean up a draft, only when you tap it, with a warning first
2 player games now live in the + menu under one dropdown
ctrl+k searches all your chats at once
bot store: rate bots with stars and sort by top rated
set a game status like roblox that shows as playing on your profile

title: bots get powers
items: bots can now have powers: react to messages, quote replies, post polls, dm people, greet new members, post on a timer
moderator bots: delete, pin and mute messages, set slow mode, remove people, change the description and make mods. a bot only gets these where the group host gives it the mod or host role
group hosts can add bots to their group themselves: group info > add a bot, pick the bot and its role. change a bot's role or remove it any time
every bot action shows up in the mod log, and bots can never act on someone who outranks them
bot builder: new block triggers (joins, timer, link, caps, any of these words), new actions, a docs panel for javascript bots and a test box that shows what the bot would do
bots show their powers in the directory and the owner sees them before approving

title: make your own bots
items: bots: build one with blocks, javascript or ai (powered by the hack club ai, with your own personality and context). find it in settings > my bots
bots run in a locked sandbox and every new bot is checked by the owner before it goes live
use any bot anywhere with /bot name your message. it only sees what you type after the name
bots can also live in public groups, take dms, or be added to private groups by an admin (with a warning, since they can read that chat)
browse all approved bots in settings > browse bots

title: game photos and cat game fix
items: games now show cover photos when we can find one, otherwise the letter tile stays
fixed Do NOT Take This Cat Home getting stuck on the loading spinner, it now loads through our own server and starts in a few seconds

title: daily word, boards, game rooms and glow-ups
items: word of the day: one word for everyone, 6 tries, streak counter and a daily top 10 (games > daily)
boards: game wins, word streaks, reactions and meme of the week. play time now stops counting when you go idle or hide the tab, and one session counts at most 3 hours
game rooms: pin a game to any chat so friends can drop in. chat stays open on a floating bubble inside every game
memes: two new templates, two buttons and change my mind. react to a meme in a public room to vote for meme of the week
profile glow-up (beta): accent color, avatar frame, favorite game, bio song or link and top 3 friends. everyone can see them
new game: Do NOT Take This Cat Home, with credits to Pixeliminal and the port by genizy (star icon in the player)
gng no longer errors out when the ai is slow, he retries and shrugs it off instead

title: memes and play together anywhere
items: new /meme command: tap up to 5 messages, pick a style (classic, screenshot, nope/yes, big brain), add captions and send it as a meme card. works for everyone
play together now works on strict networks like school wifi: if a direct connection cannot be made it switches to compatibility mode automatically (no sound there)

title: update videos and bonus events
items: every big update now comes with a short video that plays when you open chatroom, once, and you can skip it
limited-time events are coming: when one is on, inviting friends can earn extra beta time, you will see it on the beta page

title: gng is here
items: meet gng: a gen alpha chat bot that lives in Everyone. ping him with @gng, say his name, or just talk and he might drop in
hosts and mods can invite him to their public group with /gng on (or the button in group details). he cannot join private chats since those are encrypted

title: search by display name
items: finding people now works with display names too (any word in the name), not just usernames
the play together friend picker has a search box

title: play together
items: new play together button in the game player: a friend far away joins your game, sees it live and plays it with you using their keyboard and mouse (or taps on a phone)

it runs straight between your two browsers, so it costs nothing to host. use Chrome or Edge on a computer to host; works for any game in the library, though a few games that need pointer lock or a gamepad will not respond to the friend

title: replies, mods, photos and more
items: replies: tap the arrow on a message to quote it, tap a quote to jump back to it
@mentions: type @ to pick someone, they get a notification and the message is highlighted for them
search inside a chat, forward messages to other chats, and a remind me bell on every message (beta)
do not disturb: mute sounds and pushes for a while, or set daily quiet hours (settings or /dnd)
view once messages and photos in dms: they vanish after being opened (screenshots can still happen)
beta: send photos up to 5 MB, end-to-end encrypted, in dms and private groups; chat wallpapers; folder limit raised from 8 to 20
new beta games: connect 4, word duel and trivia duel
groups: hosts can pick mods, mods can mute and remove people, and anyone staff can turn on slow mode
slash commands: type / in any chat, /help lists what you can use (mods: /mute /kick /slow, admins: /ban /warn /verify /beta and more)
suspended people can now appeal from the sign in screen
admins get an audit log, appeals queue and a stats page

title: sticker link fix
items: stickers now accept any https image link, including google image thumbnails that have no .png or .jpg at the end

title: the beta tab
items: new beta tab: price ($0.50 a week), what you get, and a button to message an admin to pay

beta features: edit messages, scheduled messages, voice notes (10s), polls (up to 10 options), stickers from image links with a square crop, chat folders, tic-tac-toe and rock paper scissors, bio and gradient banner on your profile, and disappearing-message timers per chat
referrals now only count once your friend is verified, and only verified people get an invite link

title: profile pictures and fixes
items: profile pictures: pick a preset picture in you, everyone sees it next to your name
chats with admins are always free, even if you are unverified, and the verify screen has a 'talk to an admin' option
removed the faint name pattern over the app
admins no longer get the screen blur

title: safety and verification
items: chat filter: messages with inappropriate words are blocked, and names, groups and statuses are checked too
announcements: admins can post a banner that shows at the top for everyone, with an optional button
verification: scan your school or bus id, an admin approves it, and you get a blue tick. the photo is deleted as soon as it is reviewed
unverified accounts get 20 messages, no reactions and no beta until they verify
badges: earn them by doing things, like Yapper for sending 200 messages. see them under you, then badges
invite friends and your beta time now live in the top bar
two built-in servers: Everyone for all members, and the Beta lounge for people with beta
privacy: the chat blurs when you switch windows or use screenshot shortcuts, and your name is faintly tiled over the screen. this deters casual screenshots but cannot stop a phone camera

title: the big cozy update
items: reactions: tap react on any message, or type :skull: style shortcodes while writing
pins: pin up to 5 messages per chat, pinned messages stay past the 2 day vanish
easier deleting: hover toolbar, undo for 5 seconds, select several and delete in one go, hosts can clear anyone's message in their group
reporting: report a message, person or public group, admins review them in the admin panel
public groups: host an open group (3 max), find them in discover, join with one tap
game history now keeps only your last 12 sessions, older ones are deleted for good
public rooms show the last few days of chat when you join
invite friends: every friend who joins and sends a message earns you 30 minutes of beta
beta: gifs (paste a link or search) and custom themes, admins get beta by default
this changes board, updated with every change

title: cozy redesign
items: new warm look with day and night modes and smoother animations
messages vanish after 2 days
custom statuses
admin panel
